# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P88](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0088), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P88](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0088), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Thorne  <sub>[v1 c15 P88](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0088), [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)</sub>; Miss Agnes Thorne

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is a young woman with light curly hair, captivating eyes, and refined manners. She dresses gorgeously with very puffy sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P1](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0001), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an intelligent, compassionate, and sympathetic teacher who possesses a gentle spoken tone. She inspires her students and draws out their finest intellectual and moral qualities, preferring to encourage them rather than use harsh discipline or physical punishment. She is dedicated, perceptive, and firm about maintaining a strong academic foundation.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P1](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0001), [v1 c23 P4](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0004), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011), [v1 c30 P18](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0018)_

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne was hired by the school trustees as the new female teacher for Brierley school. Upon taking up her post in the autumn, she introduced innovative teaching methods, including bi-weekly recitation afternoons, field days in the woods to study nature, and daily physical culture exercises. She formed an advanced Regent's entrance class for dedicated students to provide extra instruction after school hours. During the term, she proposed organizing a Christmas Night concert to raise funds for a schoolhouse flag. Though she considered a job offer in her home district, she decided to return to Brierley school to guide her students through their final entrance examination year.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P5](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0005), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)_
